source_title: VELO Nicotine Pouches Receive U.S. FDA Marketing Authorization
source_excerpt:
WINSTON-SALEM, N.C. , Oct. 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Today, Modoral Brands Inc., an operating company of Reynolds American Inc. (Reynolds American), received U.S. FDA Marketing Granted Orders for a select number of VELO nicotine pouches.
"Today's Marketing Granted Orders demonstrate the FDA's leadership in accelerating progress toward a Smokeless America," said David Waterfield, President and CEO at Reynolds American Inc. "With adult smoking rates below 10 percent for the first time in recorded history, scienceâbased decisions like this highlight the role that FDAâauthorized alternatives can play in driving further declines in cigarette smoking."
Reynolds American [and its] companies will continue to work with FDA as it evaluates our submissions for additional products. We are confident in the science that supports our submissions and look forward to additional authorizations.
FDA's Marketing Granted Orders included the following flavors and strengths:
VELO Mini Pouch 400 mg Passion Fruit 4 mg
VELO Mini Pouch 2 400 mg Orange Crema 4 mg
Reynolds American's multicategory portfolio is aligned with where adult smokers are heading â away from combustible cigarettes. For those who continue to use nicotine, potentially less risky alternatives like responsibly marketed vapor and nicotine pouches expand options for the nearly 30 million Americans who still smoke and are looking to transition away from cigarettes.
At the same time, continued decline in smoking rates will depend on providing adult smokers with more innovative alternatives, as well as addressing a still-thriving illicit marketplace of vapor products, which evade regulation and are intentionally designed and marketed to youth.
Recently, Reynolds American announced a forward-looking planned commitment to invest more than $3.2 billion in support of the organization's continued evolution toward a predominantly smokeless future, building on momentum in high growth categories, like nicotine pouches â these authorizations support the organization's investment to grow manufacturing in America. The investment began in 2024 and is expected to support more than 2,000 direct and indirect jobs across Reynolds American's operations and U.S. supply network, including roles tied to recent manufacturing expansion and innovation initiatives.

VELO products are marketed in the United States by Modoral Brands Inc. (Modoral), an operating company of Reynolds American Inc., a member of the British American Tobacco Group. Modoral remains committed to responsibly marketing VELO products. To learn more about Modoral, visit ModoralBrands.com .
